Adds incremental revenue with state-customer validation; size is modest.
Multi-year visibility, albeit at a capped value.
Potential to extend to 5 years if performance merits.
Expands public health analytics footprint with a state agency.

This is an early-stage, small-dollar contract that supports Syra Health’s push into government analytics services. A larger win, material renewals, or disclosure of higher-value state/federal deals would make this a stronger catalyst.
